project.name: treehouse-FlaskSQL
project.summary: A Flask pet catalog renders a listing, detail and add/edit forms, commits Pet changes through SQLAlchemy and deletes through a GET handler. This is a course app, not a verified secure deployment.

nodes.label: Pet page handlers
nodes.summary: Index, details, add/edit, delete and a demonstration response are defined in app.py.

nodes.label: Pet data model
nodes.summary: models.py creates the Flask app, SQLite SQLAlchemy binding and Pet fields.

nodes.label: Jinja pet pages
nodes.summary: Layout, listing, details, forms and the missing-page template render Pet fields.

nodes.label: Form interaction and styling
nodes.summary: CSS styles pages and app.js toggles nearby radio inputs on icon clicks.

nodes.label: Local pet database
nodes.summary: SQLAlchemy commits catalog mutations to SQLite; no actual records are included.

nodes.label: Project reference and license
nodes.summary: Original course documentation and any upstream license remain separate from executable processing.
